title: Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
body:
Sarwar Ne Sada Di Roro Kar Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
Aaye Noor-e-Nazar Aaye Lagte Jigar Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
1.Jab Run Ku Chale Hum Shakle Nabi
Beh Hosh Howi Dukhyari Phuphi
Yeh Khete Chale Peeche Sarwar
<<MINI>>
Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Kis Gham Me Hai Tum Kya Jaano
Aulad Ka Gham Tum Kya Jaano
Ab Kaise Rakhe Dil Par Pathar
<<MINI>>
Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Kuch Kam Toh Yeh Gham Karte Jao
Itna Toh Karam Karte Jao
Dekho Meri Janib Mudh Mudh Kar
<<MINI>>
Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Aaye Laal Bhot Dilgir Hai Hum
Uthte Hai Badi Mushkil Se Khadam
Manzil Hai Kadi Dushwar Safar
<<MINI>>
Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Ehsas Bhi Hai Tanhai Ka
Taaza Hai Abhi Gham Bhai Ka
Zakhmi Hai Badan Tuthi Hai Kamar
<<MINI>>
Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Hai Dard Me Duba Tera Bayan
Fakhri Wo Magar Ehsas Kahan
Kis Dard Me Khete They Sarwar
<<MINI>>
Aahista Chalo Beta Akber Yabunaiya Mehlan Mehlan
